Subject: RE: Orchid pilot - publicity & concession ask (Deal-9382)

Irene —

Quick summary: Orchid (Amit & Elena) have signed a 12-month pilot but are asking for a one-time 30% first-year credit on committed capacity to accelerate PO approval. In return theyre willing to provide: logo use on our site, a short customer quote (approved by their comms), and a joint case study + two co-branded social posts. Theyre also open to a short (30-60s) customer testimonial video if we produce it.

Key items they want us to sign off on before signing:
- Permission to use logo and short quote in press/social/case study (they want a press embargo til their earnings release; they prefer the case study go live 10/25)
- A clause that allows them to require changes to the quote for legal reasons
- Slightly extended data-retention language in the MSA redline (legal already flagged)

Id like to offer the credit if we can get exec sign-off on the publicity terms and marketing usage (particularly the embargo and the quote approval flow). Attach: draft case study + MSA redline + marketing opt-in form.

Can we escalate for a quick executive decision? This is on the critical path for their PO.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa —

I think the trade is reasonable in principle, but legal flagged two things: the extended retention ask (we need a security review if they're asking >90 days for certain logs) and the embargo/exclusivity language. Legal suggests we avoid any exclusivity and limit marketing asset rights in duration.

Please escalate to Vivek with the attachments and a clear ask list (exact discount %, duration of rights, exclusivity/no-exclusivity, video ownership). Put a recommended approval path (e.g., approve 30% credit conditioned on non-exclusive logo rights for 24 months and marketing review/approval before publish).

I can join the exec thread if needed.

—Irene
Director, Deal Desk (Redwood Inference)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-19T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orchid pilot - publicity & concession ask (Deal-9382)

Thanks for the concise write-up. I read the attachments and the legal comments. I approve the concession with the following mandatory conditions:

1) Concession: one-time 30% credit applied to first-year committed spend only (no recurring catalogue change).
2) Marketing rights: non-exclusive use of logo, quote, and case study for a period of 24 months from publish date. No perpetual rights.
3) Embargo: Marketing team may agree to a time-limited embargo (up to 6 weeks) but final publish date must be agreed in writing with Marketing lead.
4) Video: Redwood will own the edited final cut for use in Redwood marketing; Orchid retains the right to request removal for regulatory reasons with 14 days notice. Any raw footage remains Orchids property.
5) Quote approvals: Orchid must approve quote text in writing. Redwood marketing must also approve final quote/creative.
6) No exclusivity: explicit clause denying any exclusivity for the sector or competitive products.
7) Legal: update data-retention to our standard profile (no elevated access to logs beyond SOC-2 standard) – Legal to finalize language in MSA addendum.
8) Signatures: both the MSA amendment and the marketing opt-in must be signed via DocuSign before credit is applied.

If legal and marketing confirm the redlines can be implemented, proceed and have Finance schedule the credit against invoice when signatures are complete. Irene/Ben/Marissa: please loop Legal and Marketing into the Drive doc and DocuSign envelope.

—Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
